slides.texte_overlay:
6 manly rules that make
you quietly attractive

1. If You Walk Into a Room...
Greet Everyone:
• Not just the people you know.
• Eye contact, a nod, a name.

2. If Someone Pays You a Compliment...
Just Say Thank You:
• No "oh, it's nothing."
• Take it with grace.

3. If the Conversation Goes Deep...
Keep Up:
• Ask good questions.
• Know a little about a lot.
• Learn something new daily.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. If You're Wrong in Public...
Own It Fast:
• "Fair point, I was wrong."
• Then move on.

5. If You Host...
Feed People Well:
• Cook one dish you're proud of.
• Make sure every glass is full.

6. If You Make a Promise...
Keep It Quietly:
• No reminders needed.
• Your word is your style.
